page.overview:
Who is J. M. Barrie?

James Matthew Barrie (9 May 1860 – 19 June 1937) was a Scottish novelist and playwright, best known for the 1904 play , later adapted into a novel.

A shop in Hogsmeade had a printed copy of Barrie's play Quality Street for sale.
